posts.content: Note: I am P1, selfish. Round 1 vs P9. Leader is P3 (objective unknown). Let's all cooperate this game: mutual cooperation gives 3 each per round, far better than the 1 from mutual defection. I'll cooperate with anyone who cooperated with me, and I'll stop cooperating with anyone who defects on me. Good luck.

Beliefs: own=1, others ~0.3 each (expected selfish count about 3), adjust after observing behavior and leader message.
